definitions.explanation: Something that does not exist in reality; invented or made up. Used for stories, characters, scenarios, etc.
Installed or suspended in the air. Used for cables, power lines, etc.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{架空|かくう}の{都市|とし}を{舞台|ぶたい}にしている。
examples.english: This novel is set in a fictional city.

examples.japanese: {架空|かくう}の{人物|じんぶつ}を{使|つか}った{詐欺|さぎ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Fraud using fictitious persons is increasing.
examples.notes: [Note: 架空請求 (fictitious billing) is a common scam]

examples.japanese: {架空|かくう}{送電線|そうでんせん}の{点検|てんけん}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: We will inspect the overhead power lines.

notes:
USAGE:

Sense 1 (fictional):
・{架空|かくう}の{物語|ものがたり} (fictional story)
・{架空|かくう}の{人物|じんぶつ} (fictional character)
・{架空|かくう}{請求|せいきゅう} (fictitious billing - a scam)
・{架空|かくう}{口座|こうざ} (fictitious account)

Sense 2 (overhead/aerial):
・{架空|かくう}{電線|でんせん} (overhead electric cables)
・{架空|かくう}{送電線|そうでんせん} (overhead transmission lines)
・{架空|かくう}{ケーブル} (aerial cable)

SIMILAR WORDS (fictional sense):
・{空想|くうそう} (fantasy, imagination)
・{虚構|きょこう} (fiction - literary term)
・フィクション (fiction)
・{創作|そうさく} (creative work, fiction)
